status: suggested formalization obligations only; no Lean source or invocation in this experiment
theorem_scope: Finite support integer e on positive integer slopes, sum e = sum j*e = 0, explicit open-phase F <= phi for (5,3).

obligations.name: floor_sum_reflection
obligations.claim: At nonbreakpoints, floor(j*(1-x))=j-1-floor(j*x); the two balance equations imply F(1-x)=-F(x).
obligations.domain: Finite support e; positive integer j; rational or real 0<x<1.

obligations.name: five_three_paired_zero
obligations.claim: phi(x)=phi(1-x)=0 on the interiors (1/8,1/4), (3/8,5/8), (3/4,7/8); explicit phase domination forces F=0 there away from breakpoints.
obligations.boundary: At x=1/2 use adjacent nonbreakpoints for jumps; do not infer a jump relation merely from an isolated phi=0 point.

obligations.name: rational_floor_jump
obligations.claim: For reduced a/b and support<=N, sufficiently small two-sided epsilon gives jump F(a/b+epsilon)-F(a/b-epsilon)=sum_{b divides j}e_j.
obligations.basis: Distinct rational numbers with denominators<=N are at least 1/N^2 apart.

obligations.name: five_three_support_le_sixteen
obligations.claim: For maximal nonzero J>16, the stated three parity-class choices of a are coprime to J and lie in (3/8,1/2); epsilon=1/(4J^2) stays in the zero interval and only the J term jumps, contradiction.
obligations.unbounded_part: This must be a uniform gcd/mod-4 proof, not the finite sanity check 17<=J<=128.

obligations.name: five_three_jump_matrix
obligations.claim: After support<=16, all eleven denominator witnesses produce the supplied integer linear equations, plus the two balance equations.

obligations.name: five_three_linear_normal_form
obligations.claim: The supplied exact row transform proves rank 13, with r=e4,s=e8,t=e10 and the listed coefficients at j=1,2,3,4,5,8,10; all others vanish.
obligations.certificate: 13-by-13 rational row transform T satisfying T*A=R, with an identity pivot block.

obligations.name: five_three_parameter_constraints
obligations.claim: Evaluations at 9/80,3/20,9/32 and their reflections give -1<=t<=0, s=-t, 0<=u=r+s<=1.
obligations.domain: All these points and reflections have reduced denominators>16, so are safe after the support bound.

obligations.name: five_three_growth_bound
obligations.claim: Exact prime exponent collection gives S=(64/27)^u*(3125/256)^t<=64/27; equality is attained by the old e1=e4=1,e2=e3=-1 vector.
obligations.certificate: prime_exponent_coefficients_u_t and four exact rational corner growth values.

obligations.name: optional_phase_classification
obligations.claim: Of the four necessary integer corners, (u,t)=(0,-1) fails at x=17/25; the other three satisfy all complete open cells for support<=16.
obligations.status: Optional stronger corollary; not needed for the requested growth upper bound.

explicitly_unverified_external_translati.name: actual_q_divisor_implies_open_phase_domination
explicitly_unverified_external_translati.claim_to_be_proved_separately: From eventual actual q_h/D integrality for every relevant m,h and fixed delta/shifts, pass to arbitrarily large prime p, choose m near p*x and h near p*y, keep 0<=h<=u and all factorial arguments<p^2, control fixed shifts away from every breakpoint, and derive the required F<=phi.
explicitly_unverified_external_translati.consequence: Current theorem must not be advertised as a bound for all actual divisors of G, all factorial methods, or B699 itself.
